rules.rule: Only plan, handoff, bug, feature, todo, and dept files are work; every other agent-* file is reported and left alone
must: `agent-plan-\*\.md`, `agent-handoff-\*\.md`, `agent-bug-\*\.md`, `agent-feature-\*\.md`, `agent-todo\.md`, or `agent-dept-\*\.md`
Every other `agent-\*` file \(`agent-decisions\.md`, a script, an image\) is seen, reported, and never changed

rules.rule: Paths the user's instructions mark read-only or forbidden are skipped and listed with their rule
must: Skip every path the user's loaded instructions \(`CLAUDE\.md`, `AGENTS\.md`, rules files\) mark read-only or forbid editing
record each with the rule that skips it

rules.rule: A file outside any repository is a unit of its own folder, worked without commits
must: a no-repo unit, worked without commits

rules.rule: Everything foreseeable is asked up front, one question per message; nothing is edited or started before the last answer
must: one question per message, most blocking first, saying how many remain
Edit nothing, commit nothing, and start no agent before the last answer

rules.rule: Each item is classed runs, asks, or waiting; a waiting item is reported and left alone
must: \*\*runs\*\* \(nothing blocks it\), \*\*asks\*\*
\*\*waiting\*\* \(its condition cannot be met now
reported and left alone

rules.rule: Units are ordered by dependency: a consumer after the library it requires
must: requires a module another selected unit holds goes after that unit

rules.rule: At most five agents at once, never two on one unit
must: Run at most five agents at once
never two on one unit

rules.rule: A brief carries only what its items name: no unchecked step of the orchestrator's own and no trailer instruction; the report never mentions trailers
must: Put only what its items name in a brief; before adding a step of your own, check that it changes something in that unit
`craft:cm` owns the commit message, so add no trailer instruction, and never mention trailers or their absence in the report

rules.rule: Each dispatch is budgeted: cap min(4 GB, budget), none below 1.5 GB
must: the budget is available memory minus 4 GB minus the caps of the running workers
A new worker gets a cap of min\(4 GB, budget\); none starts while the budget is under 1\.5 GB

rules.rule: Without systemd-run, the up-front questions ask whether builds and tests may run uncapped; a no ends the run
must: `systemd-run` is missing, how many workers to run and whether builds and tests may run without a memory cap \(a no ends the run\)

rules.rule: Mid-run questions are queued, asked one at a time, and the worker resumed with the answer
must: resume that worker \(`SendMessage`\) with the answer

rules.rule: Work a worker writes into another unit is approved or skipped by the user before it runs
must: ask: approve or skip
a finished unit runs again

rules.rule: A failure is a question: retry, park, or stop the unit; dependants are held
must: retry with guidance; park
undoes its own edits by inverse edit
Hold every unit that depends on it

rules.rule: A consumer of a library waits for the user's release and is raised to exactly the tag they name
must: release and push <module>, then reply with the tag
raises its requirement to exactly that tag
That is the only dependency bump this skill makes

rules.rule: The skill never pushes, tags, releases, or bumps versions
must: Never tag, release, push, bump a version

rules.rule: The run file sits in the repo's tmp/agent, else the start folder's tmp/agent, else the start folder
must: in `<repo>/tmp/agent/` when started inside a repository; else in `<start>/tmp/agent/` when `<start>/tmp/` exists; else in the start folder

rules.rule: The run file is written with the file tools, never through the shell
must: Write it with the file tools \(Write, Edit\), never through the shell

rules.rule: A resumed run never re-asks a recorded answer
must: never ask again a question it records an answer to

rules.rule: Report counts come from git log and the run file, in the fixed first-line shape; the run file's report repeats the chat's Open list
must: worked N of M items in K commits across U units
Read every count and hash off `git log <start>\.\.HEAD`
the Open list exactly as the chat shows it

rules.rule: A worker edits only its unit and writes spill-over as todo or handoff files
must: Edit only this unit
never as a code edit

rules.rule: A worker starts no agent but the commit-gate reviewer; looping skills go back to the orchestrator
must: `cm` starts `go-change-reviewer`: the only agent you may start
return NEEDS-SKILL; never run it

rules.rule: A plan item already done is marked Y with evidence, not redone
must: before each N item, check the code\. Already done: mark it Y with the evidence

rules.rule: Bugs and features are built test-first
must: test-first — a test that fails for the right reason

rules.rule: Builds and tests run capped; a cap kill or a 10-minute stall returns FAILED
must: A kill at the cap: return FAILED; never retry with a larger cap
with no output for 10 minutes

rules.rule: A worker whose brief says `Memory cap: none` runs each build and test bare, one at a time
must: Memory cap: <cap, or "none" where `systemd-run` is missing>
with `Memory cap: none`, as `<cmd>` alone

rules.rule: A worker never weakens a test or discards work
must: Never weaken, skip, gate, or retry a test
undo your own edits by inverse edit

rules.rule: A work file drops each finished entry and is deleted once nothing open or needed is left
must: a done todo line or a paid dept entry removed
Delete a work file as soon as nothing open or needed is left in it; a section that says only "None\." holds nothing, and content under a dept file's `## Notes, not debt` keeps the file

rules.rule: A worker runs single commands by absolute path and retries a denied one in that form before failing
must: Run one command per call, by absolute path or with `git -C <unit>`
A denied command is not a denied tool: retry it once in that form before returning FAILED
